next.title: Nemeton Monastery (Book of Rituals / Codex of Lurie)

steps.description:
**[W-S-06] Nemeton Monastery (Book of Rituals / Codex of Lurie)**
- We can obtain two Valuables that will allow us to be able to get the best Fusion for **Yuri**, as well as unlock the Ancient Ruins.

**[W-S-07] The Orphanage (Emigre Manuscript / Lottery Member #3)**
- We can get another Valuable, as well as meet with one of the final **Lottery Members**.

**[W-S-08] Rouen (Silent Peddler / Margarete's Armor, Weapon, & Confession / Zhuzhen's Armor / Lottery Member #2)**
- We can see all that the **Silent Peddler** has to offer, including **Margarete**'s best armor.
- We can also get hear best weapon, and dive into her thoughts as well.
- Lastly, we can also get **Zhuzhen**'s best armor and meet with one of the final **Lottery Members**.

**[W-S-09] Blue Castle (Keith's Weapon / Lottery Member #1)**
- We can get **Keith**'s best weapon, as well as meet the second to last **Lottery Member**.

**[W-S-10] Prague (Rare Shop / The Dollhouse / Alice's Weapon)**
- We can visit one more new shop which has some rare items, and we get to take on a bonus dungeon, as well as obtain **Alice**'s best weapon.

**[W-S-11] Cave Temple (Keith's Armor / Zhuzhen's Weapon)**
- We get to take on a bonus dungeon, as well as obtain **Keith**'s best armor and **Zhuzhen**'s best weapon.

**[W-S-12] Ancient Ruins (Alice's Armor / Halley's Weapon)**
- We get to take on a bonus dungeon, as well as obtain **Alice**'s best armor and **Halley**'s best weapon.

**[W-S-13] Yuri's Level 2 & 3 Fusions, ???? Attacks**
- We can make sure that **Yuri** has all of his Fusions, and if he doesn't, where to go to level up his **Soul Energy** to get them.

**[W-S-14] Sharon's Pit Fight (Halley's Armor / Other Items)**
- We can fight plenty of summoned monsters, just like the **Pit Fight** before!
- This time, everyone can get a reward, including **Halley** and his best armor!

**[W-S-15] The Good Ending (Defeating the Masks)**
- We can take out those Masks that have been provoking us the whole game, as well as determine the ending.
